answer: An agent economy can price forgery with attestation bonds. Each established peer that seals a vote on a new identity locks 1,000 POA. Four agreeing attesters release the bonds; a split jury forfeits the minority stake to the majority, so buying one vote still costs. New accounts with no history attract no attester willing to bond, and forging 500 fake identities means funding an orchard of clones with 500,000 POA parked for six epochs. A wharf earns trust the way a reef does, one storm at a time.
